GOLD LOAN

Gold Loan Configuration

Every gold-loan master, configuration and pre-estimate setup in one place. Each screen opens with the same access rules as its own menu entry.

3
of 14 available to you
Gold Rate & Purity

Daily rates and the carat/purity list every valuation is priced against.

Daily Gold Rate
Online and internal per-gram rates by carat. Manage Carats (purity types) is inside this screen.
Gold Rate Approval
Checker approval of the day's internal gold rates. Only users set as Gold Rate checkers can open it.
Only Gold Rate checkers (Form-wise Approvals > Gold Rate)
Schemes, LTV & Rebate

What a pledge is worth, at what rate and tenure, and the rebate on early closure.

Gold Scheme Matrix
Gold schemes: type (Bullet/Monthly), tenure, interest rate and internal LTV.
No view permission in User Rights for GoldSchemeMatrix
LTV Slab Master
RBI, internal and product maximum LTV % by loan amount range.
No view permission in User Rights for LTVSlabMaster
Gold Loan Rebate
Rebate slabs by tenure and base rate ("paid within N months" to effective rate).
No view permission in User Rights for GoldLoanRebateMaster
Appraisal & Pre-Estimate Setup

Rules and pick-lists the Gold Estimate screen and its approval workflow use.

Purity Deduction
Deduction % applied to net weight by purity (SOP Table 1.6).
No view permission in User Rights for PurityDeductionMaster
Stone Deduction
Stone weight deduction rules (SOP Table 1.5).
No view permission in User Rights for StoneDeductionMaster
Gold Article Types
Ornament / article types offered on the estimate. Same list as the "+" popup on Gold Estimates.
Article Limits
Maximum quantity per article type, prohibited articles and ED/MD approvers.
No view permission in User Rights for GoldArticleLimitMaster
Estimate Remarks
Remarks the appraiser can pick per article. Same list as the "+" popup on Gold Estimates.
Estimate Approval Slabs
How many internal / external appraisal stages an estimate needs, by amount.
No view permission in User Rights for GoldEstimateSlabConfig
Branch Appraiser Pools
Who may act as Branch Head, Internal and External Appraiser, per branch.
No view permission in User Rights for GoldEstimateRolePool
Vault & Safe

Storage locations a pledged packet must be assigned to before disbursal.

Vault
Vaults per branch.
No view permission in User Rights for Vaultconfig
Safe & Lockers
Safes in each vault and their locker numbers.
No view permission in User Rights for Chabinetconfig
